answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 31106 Country: India Title: My question is related to any kind of bank loan and haj. Is it true that as long as I have any kind of loan against me I can not go for the Haj. Question: My question is related to any kind of bank loan and haj. Is it true that as long as I have any kind of loan against me I can not go for the Haj. Answer ID: 31106 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 482/482/M=1432) It is not right to take interest-based loan from the bank without exigent need. If you have taken loan unknowingly, it is better to pay the debt before going to hajj. If it is not demanded urgently and you left for hajj being sure that you would pay it after returning from hajj, then your hajj will definitely be valid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
